name: Nagykőrös (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and green at the fly, charged near the top with the town arms of Nagykőrös (a crowned red oval with a green tree within a yellow frame) above the name NAGYKŐRÖS in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagykőrös arms with crown and frame
